What changed:
- Standardized the lifecycle contract on `Actor` around `tick(SimulationContext)`, with a small legacy `act(List<Actor>)` adapter left in place for compatibility. See [Actor.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R016_module_java/Actor.java#L9).
- Added a shared per-step state object, `SimulationContext`, so entities can access the active actors, spawned actors, night/day state, and water-generation requests without simulator-specific branching. See [SimulationContext.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R016_module_java/SimulationContext.java#L6).
- Simplified `Simulator` to a single `tick` loop over all actors, with only expiration removal and post-step water generation remaining. The type checks and special-case disease/weather handling were removed from the main loop. See [Simulator.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R016_module_java/Simulator.java#L122).
- Moved shared organism lifecycle work into `Organism`: aging, water decay, water-seeking threshold handling, and expiration are now centralized. See [Organism.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R016_module_java/Organism.java#L44).
- Aligned `Animal` and `Plant` with the new lifecycle shape:
  - both implement `tick(SimulationContext)`
  - both use the shared spawn list from context
  - both rely on the shared water-threshold logic in `Organism`
  - animal birth and plant birth follow the same structural pattern
  See [Animal.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R016_module_java/Animal.java#L44) and [Plant.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R016_module_java/Plant.java#L31).
- Updated environmental actors to the same lifecycle contract:
  - `Disease.tick(...)` now owns infection spread and spontaneous infection
  - `Weather.tick(...)` now owns weather effects and requests water generation through context
  See [Disease.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R016_module_java/Disease.java#L49) and [Weather.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R016_module_java/Weather.java#L27).
